attacks.name: Katana
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Throwing Glaives
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!hit| |*Pursuit|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Night of the Dhampir
steps: If the defender has the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition, this character may reroll any number of attack dice.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the Bleed special condition.
After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Bump in the Night (Affiliation: Midnight Sons)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, at any time during an allied character's Activation, it may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, Place that character within |!range| 1 of its current position.

superPowers.name: Half-Blood Physiology
superPowers.body: This character immediately performs a Shake action.

superPowers.name: Supernatural Senses
superPowers.body: While this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!mystic| attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its defense dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Vampiric Immortality
superPowers.body: At the end of this character's Activation, it gains 1 |!power| and removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each other character within |!range| 2 of it that has the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

"Throwing Glaives" was added a Pursuit special rule.
Timing for Supernatural Sense was changed from "after rolling its defense dice" to "during the Modify Dice step of the attack".
